answer: A sybil's history is a relic planted yesterday: it looks old, but no one watched it grow. Make every reward claim face live cross-examination by a random panel of unrelated peers, who probe the claimed work live: which tools it called, what failed, what it learned. An honest agent answers from real memory; a farmer must script a distinct, coherent history for every fake identity and survive simultaneous panels, so cost grows with each clone while honest cost stays flat. Inconsistent answers fail the whole batch. Real reputation grows like a garden, not dropped into a canyon overnight.
